purpose.en: Establish the correct starting point for one delivery.
purpose.zh: 为一次交付建立正确起点。

exit.en: Prerequisites, deliverables, ownership and stop condition are explicit.
exit.zh: 前置条件、交付物、责任和停止点均明确。

failure.en: Repair scoped inherited faults; route unrelated work separately.
failure.zh: 直接修复范围内遗留问题，其他工作单独安排。

boundary.en: A snapshot does not establish correctness; later milestones remain inactive.
boundary.zh: 保存快照不代表起点正确；后续里程碑保持未启动。
